candidate_traditions.note: Edo earthwork walls and royal palace complex, Benin City. Directly connected to material already preserved in this project's own research pack (British Museum 1897 provenance records).
Ethiopian Gondarine stone castle complex — battlemented towers, cut-stone walls, royal compound.
Coursed dry-stone enclosure walling; no mortar, so the mortar fields of a masonry spec resolve to zero rather than UNKNOWN.
Massive earthen city walls and gates with royal compounds inside.
Coral-rag and lime-mortar coastal stone towns and forts.
Nile-corridor fired-brick and stone fortified royal architecture.
Rammed-earth and mudbrick fortified compounds with corner towers.
Curtain wall, gatehouse, keep. Listed as one candidate among several, not as the default.
Ashlar curtain and tower fortress traditions.
Fort-palace complexes with layered gates and ramped elephant/cart approaches.
Dry-stone battered plinth carrying a timber-framed superstructure.

bleed_rule: Other time periods may exist elsewhere on the planet. No object may enter this scene from a frame outside THYW-FRAME-CASTLE-001's lineage, and no technology may enter this scene that is not on this profile's allow-list.
school_architecture_rule: Learning and tutorial spaces are recorded as rooms of this period's household, not as classrooms. Modern school architecture is prohibited.
